cards.t: Chainflip Loses $12 Million in Vault Exploit
cards.b: Cross-chain protocol Chainflip suffered a vault exploit resulting in the theft of $12 million in assets, including BTC, ETH, and stablecoins. The project offered the attacker a 10% bounty to return 90% of the funds by November 23.

per.FLIP: Fell sharply by up to 34% following the vault drain and suspected key compromise.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST
cards.missing: Whether the hacker accepts the bounty and returns the funds.

cards.t: Cyber Investigates Bridge Exploit After South Korean Exchanges Freeze Transfers
cards.b: South Korean exchanges Upbit, Bithumb, and others suspended CYBER deposits and withdrawals following unexpected token minting on Solana and suspicious movements from the Ethereum bridge lockbox.

per.CYBER: Transfers halted on major South Korean exchanges amid the ongoing security investigation.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST
cards.missing: Total exact amount stolen and vulnerability specifics.

cards.t: Hashi Launches on Sui Mainnet to Turn Bitcoin into Lending Collateral
cards.b: Hashi has officially gone live on the Sui mainnet, enabling native Bitcoin to be utilized as lending collateral on the network.

per.BTC: Gains a new utility layer allowing holders to use it as lending collateral on Sui.

cards.label: COMPLETED CATALYST
cards.missing: Total value locked and adoption metrics following launch.
